message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful take on isolation and madness. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family drama that turns into a full‑blown nightmare. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart blend of horror and social commentary. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Tension built around silence—perfect for a nerve‑wracking experience. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror that feels unsettlingly normal. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “you’re being stalked” trope. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑world folklore. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror that digs deep into grief. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Slow‑burn dread set in 1630s New England. |
|10 | **Suspiria** | 2018 | A visually striking remake of the 1977 classic. |

Feel free to pick one that matches your mood—whether you want a psychological scare, supernatural chills, or a modern twist on the genre. Enjoy the fright!
